text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Famous fun park owner in western province of Izmir kills two people in frenzy caused by heroin withdrawal.
- Turkish justice minister invites the chairman of the European Human Right Commission to Turkey.
- State Minister Abdullah Gul warns Europe against statements accusing Turkey of supporting international drug traffic.
- The revenue to be raised from privatisation in 1997 will be swallowed up by black holes such as massive social security deficits.
- The Netherlands also accuses Turkey of supporting international drug trade.
- Islamist justice minister gearing up to prevent models' appearing on podium wearing swimming suits.
- High ranking foreign ministry official says if Turkey is not given green light for full membership of European Union by June, it will freeze its relations with EU.
ZAMAN - Eighty Turkish companies active in the Middle East are among the biggest 500 companies in the region.
